sentences: I dip the mop in a pan.
nwf_note: No nonsense-word subtest: the taught letters spell thirteen legal pseudowords, but ten of them are heard as a real word, a respelling or slang -- ap ("app"), dat ("that"), fom ("foam"), ip (the letters I-P), nad (slang), nin ("nine"), nop ("nope"), op and ot (bare rimes), som ("some"). Only fim, mip and pid survive being said aloud, and three items are not the five-item subtest this measure needs.
instrument_claim: Decoding check on this lesson's taught sound. NOT a clean alternate form: below Lesson 13 the published Form A already spends every on-target word that exists, so some overlap is unavoidable and a child who practised at home may have met these words. Read the score as 'can they decode these taught patterns', not as an independent re-test.
